INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DURABILITY.title: Durability
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DURABILITY.description: Loses durability based on the target's attack damage when attacking an enemy intending to attack. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] when durability reaches zero.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RECON.title: Recon
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RECON.description: Look at the top X cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. You may put any of them into your [gold]Hand[/gold], and [gold]Discard[/gold] any of them.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RECALL.title: Recall
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-RECALL.description: If this card is in neither your [gold]Hand[/gold] nor your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], return it to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
